sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Energy Transfer shifts unit trading to Texas exchange
feed.summary: Energy Transfer (ET) is delisting its common and Series I preferred units from the New York Stock Exchange, with trading ceasing on October 2, 2026. The company will transition its trading to the Texas Stock Exchange starting October 5, 2026, under the same tickers. This strategic move aims to align the Texas-based energy operator with TXSE's technology-driven platform.

feed.title: Livonia homeowner gets resolution from DTE months after storm damage
feed.summary: A Livonia homeowner, Dave Pietrowski, finally received a resolution from DTE Energy months after storm damage left his yard in disarray and a utility pole leaning precariously. After repeated unsuccessful attempts to get the issue fixed, Pietrowski contacted 7 News Detroit, which prompted DTE to dispatch crews to complete the repairs and landscaping. DTE apologized for the delay and urged customers to contact them with concerns.

feed.title: Expanding Healthcare Access With NMTC Equity Investment
feed.summary: J.P. Morgan provided a $7.5 million New Markets Tax Credit (NMTC) equity investment to support the Sankofa Village Wellness Center in Chicago's West Garfield Park, an underserved community. This center, opened in 2026, aims to expand access to quality healthcare and other vital services like fitness and employment assistance, addressing a significant disparity in life expectancy and health outcomes. The NMTC investment also facilitates future community ownership of the facility, empowering local residents.

feed.title: Fitch upgrades Citizens Financial rating on profitability By Investing.com
feed.summary: Fitch Ratings has upgraded Citizens Financial Group and its subsidiary Citizens Bank to 'A-' from 'BBB+', citing consistent improvements in earnings power and profitability. The upgrade reflects sustained margin expansion, stable credit costs, and growth in fee-generating businesses like private banking and capital markets. This move aligns Citizens Financial's credit profile with its large regional peers, recognizing its strong market presence and diverse revenue streams.

feed.title: Public Service Enterprise Group CEO Sells 2,083 Shares
feed.summary: Public Service Enterprise Group (NYSE:PEG) CEO Ralph A. LaRossa sold 2,083 shares of the company stock for $153,000 on September 1, 2026. This transaction represents 0.7% of his direct holdings, and he still retains over 281,000 shares. Despite the stock's 11.7% decline over the past year, analysts have a mixed outlook, with a median one-year price target suggesting an 18.8% gain.

feed.title: Can Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) Keep Pace as Costs Rise?
feed.summary: This article examines how Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) is navigating a challenging macro environment characterized by rising costs, firm Treasury yields, and inflation concerns. It highlights the importance of company-specific execution in addressing increased operating expenses and maintaining demand momentum, especially given the company's direct ties to capital spending, aerospace and defense demand, automation trends, and supply-chain execution. The piece emphasizes that market attention is currently focused on how businesses like Rockwell Automation absorb higher costs without losing demand, making operational clarity and disciplined resource deployment critical.

feed.title: BIGY ETF Price and Chart — TSX:BIGY
feed.summary: The BIGY ETF, or Evolve US Equity UltraYield ETF Trust Units -Hedged-, primarily invests in US equities with a strategy to enhance yield and reduce volatility through covered call writing and leverage. The fund was incepted on September 9, 2025, and manages its currency exposure through hedged and unhedged units. It also engages in securities lending for additional income, with current assets under management at 358.53 million CAD and a dividend yield of 42.28%.

feed.title: Northrop Grumman wins two U.S. defense contracts worth $38.7m
feed.summary: Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. has secured two U.S. defense contracts totaling approximately $38.7 million. One contract, valued at nearly $20 million, is for the procurement of non-standard ammunition by its Radford, Virginia division. The second contract, an $18.7 million modification, tasks its Oklahoma City division with manufacturing B-2 hot trailing edges.

feed.title: IDW Announces Results for Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026
feed.summary: IDW Media Holdings, Inc. (OTCQB:IDWM) reported its financial results for the third quarter ended July 31, 2026. The company will host a conference call on September 14, 2026, at 4:30 PM Eastern time for a Q&A session regarding these results. IDW is an integrated media company focused on developing intellectual property across comics, graphic novels, television, and other entertainment platforms.

feed.title: Annexon at Cantor Fitzgerald conference: eye data, gbs progress By Investing.com
feed.summary: Annexon presented at the Cantor Fitzgerald Global Healthcare Conference, highlighting positive clinical data for its two late-stage neuroinflammatory disease programs. The company's lead eye drug, vonaprument, showed significant vision preservation in geographic atrophy, with an enrollment ahead of schedule for its Phase III ARCHER II study. Additionally, Annexon reported a 100% response rate in open-label data for its Guillain-Barré syndrome program, with regulatory filings underway in Europe and planned for the FDA.

feed.title: Thrivent Financial sells $91,518 in Gloo Holdings stock
feed.summary: Thrivent Financial for Lutherans, a major shareholder in Gloo Holdings (NASDAQ:GLOO), recently sold $91,518 worth of the company's Class A Common Stock across three transactions in early September 2026. These sales occurred as the stock traded near its 52-week low. Despite these insider sales, Gloo Holdings recently reported strong second-quarter revenues and a raised 2026 outlook, leading analysts like StoneX and Citizens to reiterate positive ratings.

feed.title: Northrop Grumman wins two U.S. defense contracts worth $38.7m By Investing.com
feed.summary: Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. has been awarded two U.S. defense contracts totaling approximately $38.7 million. One contract, worth nearly $20 million, is for non-standard ammunition procurement, while the other, valued at over $18.7 million, is a modification to an existing order for B-2 hot trailing edges manufacturing. These contracts highlight Northrop Grumman's ongoing role in providing critical defense supplies and components to the U.S. Department of War.

feed.title: Delta flight dips 27000 feet, oxygen masks drop
feed.summary: A Delta Air Lines flight from Los Angeles to Salt Lake City experienced a pressurization issue, causing oxygen masks to deploy and the aircraft to descend 27,000 feet in about 10 minutes. This incident, which diverted the flight to Las Vegas, occurred less than a week after another Delta flight also had a pressurization problem. The FAA is investigating both events, while Delta apologized to passengers for the experience.

feed.title: Enphase Energy (ENPH) Stock Looks Fairly Valued Despite New Product Hopes
feed.summary: Enphase Energy (ENPH) stock appears fairly valued based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model, suggesting it's slightly undervalued, despite a 76.4% price drop over five years. However, its P/E ratio indicates it's overvalued compared to its fair multiple. The company's future hinges on new products like IQ Solid-State Transformer modules for AI data centers and the IQ EV Charger 2, which could drive future cash flows and address the mixed valuation signals.

feed.title: Insider Selling: Home Depot (NYSE:HD) CAO Sells $206,516.25 in Stock
feed.summary: Home Depot's Chief Accounting Officer, Kimberly Scardino, sold 675 shares of company stock for $206,516.25, reducing her stake by 7.62%. This transaction comes as Home Depot reported strong quarterly earnings, exceeding revenue and EPS expectations, and declared a $2.33 per share dividend. Despite a "Moderate Buy" consensus from analysts, concerns remain regarding customer traffic and housing market conditions.

feed.title: Adobe Beats on Both Lines But Guides Below Consensus
feed.summary: Adobe Inc. (NASDAQ:ADBE) surpassed third-quarter revenue and earnings expectations, with revenue rising 13% to a record $6.76 billion and non-GAAP earnings at $6.13 per share. However, the company's stock fell premarket after guiding fourth-quarter revenue below Wall Street consensus. Adobe highlighted strong AI-first annual recurring revenue growth and an expanded user base as key positives.

feed.title: Seagate Technology Holdings Insider Sold Shares Worth $493,355, According to a Recent SEC Filing
feed.summary: An insider at Seagate Technology Holdings sold shares valued at $493,355, as reported in a recent SEC filing. This transaction is part of a series of insider sales from the company, with other filings on the same day indicating sales of over $2 million and $1 million. Seagate Technology Holdings is a leading manufacturer of data storage systems, with products sold under various brands including Seagate and LaCie.

feed.title: William Frank Jr. Cruger Sells 6,164 Shares of MarketAxess (NASDAQ:MKTX) Stock
feed.summary: Director William Frank Jr. Cruger sold 6,164 shares of MarketAxess (NASDAQ:MKTX) stock for over $1 million, reducing his direct stake by 60.45%. This sale comes as MarketAxess reported strong quarterly earnings, exceeding analyst estimates, despite a slight year-over-year revenue decline. The stock maintains a "Hold" consensus rating among analysts, with a modest dividend yield.

feed.title: Goldman, BofA vie to manage Anthropic employee wealth post-IPO - report
feed.summary: Major Wall Street banks, including Goldman Sachs and Bank of America, are reportedly competing to manage the wealth of Anthropic PBC employees after the AI company's planned initial public offering. Anthropic has solicited proposals from various financial firms regarding wealth management services, fees, and operational details. This initiative aims to help employees manage their expected financial gains post-IPO, similar to how SpaceX employees collectively negotiated wealth management services before their company's public listing.

feed.title: Adobe Beats on Both Lines But Guides Below Consensus
feed.summary: Adobe Inc. reported a beat on both revenue and earnings for its third quarter, with revenue rising 13% to a record $6.76 billion and non-GAAP earnings at $6.13 per share. Despite the strong quarterly performance and significant growth in AI-first annual recurring revenue, the company's fourth-quarter revenue guidance fell slightly below analyst consensus, leading to a premarket stock decline. Adobe also repurchased approximately 9.5 million shares, reducing its share count.

feed.title: JPMorgan cut off Situational Awareness lending after AI losses, FT reports
feed.summary: JPMorgan Chase has reportedly ceased its lending activities to Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, following significant losses incurred from its AI-related investments. The hedge fund was compelled to liquidate most of its public equities portfolio to Citadel after a widespread selloff in global chip stocks negatively impacted its leveraged positions. Other major banks like Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and Bank of America continue their brokerage relationships with Situational Awareness.

feed.title: ADM’s ex-CFO gets SEC to produce over 307,000 documents in fraud case
feed.summary: The SEC's accounting fraud lawsuit against former Archer-Daniels-Midland CFO Vikram Luthar is progressing, with the SEC having already provided over 307,000 documents during the discovery phase. Both parties anticipate a complex fact-finding process, planning up to 40 interrogatories and additional requests, with a target completion date of March 23, 2027. Luthar maintains his innocence, asserting he acted with integrity throughout his tenure at ADM.

feed.title: Gran Tierra Energy Inc. Announces Consent Solicitation for Senior Secured Amortizing Notes due 2031
feed.summary: Gran Tierra Energy Inc. announced a consent solicitation from holders of its 9.750% Senior Secured Amortizing Notes due 2031. The solicitation aims to amend the indenture to facilitate the sale of Gran Tierra Energy CI GmbH to Maurel et Prom S.A. and its subsidiary, including enabling the assumption of note obligations by the purchaser. The Proposed Amendments will update accounting standards, financial reporting covenants, and designate certain acquisitions as "Permitted Investments."

feed.title: Goldman Sachs, BofA compete for Anthropic employee wealth management - Bloomberg
feed.summary: Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Bank of New York Mellon, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo are vying to manage the wealth of Anthropic PBC employees ahead of the AI company's anticipated IPO. Anthropic, known for its Claude AI, has solicited pitches from financial firms regarding wealth management services and fee structures. This competition highlights Wall Street's interest in securing new clients from the substantial wealth expected to be generated by the IPO, similar to past tech company listings.

feed.title: Gilead Wins Appeals Court Ruling Blocking Imported HIV Drug Sales
feed.summary: Gilead Sciences, Inc. has won a federal appeals court ruling that upholds a preliminary injunction blocking the importation and sale of foreign-market Gilead-branded HIV medications in the US. The Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals found that the foreign versions were materially different from the US-marketed drugs, supporting Gilead's claims of trademark violation and unfair competition. This decision protects Gilead's Biktarvy revenue and sets a favorable precedent for drugmakers against similar import programs, though pricing pressures from employer health plans seeking lower-cost alternatives are expected to persist.

feed.title: Estée Lauder’s Lawsuit Over Alleged Counterfeits Sold On Walmart Moves Forward, Says Report
feed.summary: A federal judge has allowed Estée Lauder to broaden its lawsuit against Walmart, which alleges that counterfeit luxury cosmetics and fragrances are being sold on Walmart.com by third-party vendors. The ruling denies Walmart's motion to dismiss and permits Estée Lauder to expand its claims beyond the initial 17 products tested as fake. This case could establish significant legal precedents regarding e-commerce platforms' responsibility for policing third-party sellers.

feed.title: State Street’s PRSD ETF Celebrates 1 Year of Strong Performance
feed.summary: The State Street Short Duration IG Public & Private Credit ETF (PRSD) has demonstrated strong performance in its first year, returning 3.46% at NAV and outperforming its benchmark by 93 basis points. The ETF ranks first among 10 active short-term bond peers in total return and Sharpe ratio, while also having the smallest maximum drawdown. PRSD achieves this by combining public and private credit, expanding yield potential and offering a differentiated approach to short-duration fixed income.

feed.title: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) Sets New 52-Week High - Should You Buy?
feed.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) recently hit a new 52-week high of $91.37, despite cautious analyst sentiment with a "Hold" consensus rating and an average price target of $85.40. The company exceeded quarterly expectations with $1.47 EPS and $9.78 billion in revenue, and announced a $0.96 quarterly dividend (4.2% yield). However, insider selling of 500,000 shares occurred over the last quarter.

feed.title: Fastly CEO Charles Lacey Compton III Executes Sale of 2,436 Shares Under Rule 10b5-1 Plan
feed.summary: Fastly CEO Charles Lacey Compton III sold 2,436 shares of Class A Common Stock on September 8, 2026, for $21.23 per share. This sale was conducted under a pre-established Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted on May 11, 2026. Following the transaction, Compton directly holds 902,341 shares of Fastly's Class A Common Stock.

feed.title: Hilton CMO steps down
feed.summary: Mark Weinstein has stepped down as Hilton Worldwide Holdings' global chief marketing officer and head of luxury brands after more than 16 years. He joined Hilton in 2010, became CMO in 2020, and added the global CMO and luxury brands title in 2025. During his tenure, Weinstein oversaw brand and performance marketing for 28 brands and significantly grew the Hilton Honors loyalty program to over 250 million members.

feed.title: Herzfeld Credit Income Fund, Inc. To Conduct a Tender Offer for up to 5% of Outstanding Common Shares
feed.summary: Herzfeld Credit Income Fund, Inc. (Nasdaq: HERZ) announced its intention to commence a tender offer for up to 5% of its outstanding shares at 97.5% of NAV, beginning by October 31, 2026. This initiative is part of an ongoing plan to address the Fund's trading price discount to its net asset value. The offer will proceed if the average discount was greater than 10% for the fiscal year just ended, with formal terms to be announced soon.

feed.title: Kalshi stock futures plan targets Tesla and Apple shares - Bloomberg
feed.summary: Kalshi Inc. is planning to file for regulatory approval to offer single-stock perpetual futures in the U.S., focusing on shares of Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia. The New York-based company intends to submit its application to the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and Securities and Exchange Commission as early as next week. If approved, these would be the first single-stock perpetual futures offered in the United States, marking a significant expansion for newer trading platforms.

feed.title: Beyond Air at cantors conference: generation 2 is the focus
feed.summary: Beyond Air is focusing on securing FDA approval for its Generation 2 LungFit nitric oxide platform by the end of 2026, which is crucial for expanding its addressable market in patient transport settings. The company aims to increase its U.S. addressable market to $400 million and global market to $1 billion with Generation 2, reiterating 2026 revenue guidance of $8 million and projecting $16 million to $18 million for 2027 based on Generation 2 approval. Despite its strong customer retention for Generation 1, the company emphasizes that Generation 2 is key to doubling revenue and driving significant future growth.

feed.title: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE) In Focus As Oil & Yields Drive A Fresh Sector Rotation
feed.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE) is currently a focal point in financial markets due to the impact of elevated oil prices, firm Treasury yields, and renewed inflation concerns driving a sector rotation. The article emphasizes that ICE's performance is being assessed through a changed macro backdrop, highlighting its connection to credit conditions, capital markets activity, deposit competition, and the yield curve shape. It suggests that company-specific execution and operational clarity are crucial for ICE to navigate the current environment of higher costs and uneven demand within the Financial Stocks sector.

feed.title: What is Intel? The semiconductor company explained
feed.summary: Intel, founded in 1968 by Robert Noyce and Gordon Moore, is a leading American semiconductor company that designs and manufactures microprocessors and related hardware. It pioneered the microprocessor in 1971 with the Intel 4004 and established its x86 architecture as the standard for personal computers. The company operates in chip design and fabrication, selling products for PCs, data centers, networking, and increasingly focusing on AI data center demand.

feed.title: Context center replaces contact center at Webex CX
feed.summary: Cisco Systems Inc. is transforming traditional contact centers into "context centers" within its Webex customer experience division, focusing on maintaining continuous customer history across all touchpoints. Vinod Muthukrishnan, VP and GM of Webex customer experience, explains this shift as "agentic CX," moving beyond simple transactional bots to orchestrating entire customer relationships. The initiative, highlighted at "The AI ROI in Contact Center Summit," emphasizes building secure and observable AI agents through a unified control plane called AI Agent 360, ensuring a seamless and accountable customer experience.

feed.title: Essex Property Trust to Present at The Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference 2026
feed.summary: Essex Property Trust, Inc. announced that its President and CEO, Angela L. Kleiman, will participate in a roundtable presentation at the 2026 Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference on September 16, 2026, at 10:20 a.m. Eastern Time. A webcast of the presentation will be available on the company's investors website, with an archive accessible for thirty days. Essex Property Trust is an S&P 500 REIT focusing on multifamily residential properties in West Coast markets.

feed.title: Salesforce Enterprise AI Harness latest salvo aimed at ServiceNow
feed.summary: Salesforce has introduced its new Enterprise AI Harness, consolidating features from six different products, to compete with ServiceNow and other vendors in managing multi-vendor AI agents. This product aims to give users more governance tools for AI agents and the data they access, addressing concerns about the "SaaSpocalypse" and the need for cross-vendor orchestration in AI environments. Salesforce views this as a strategic move to simplify and consolidate the agentic AI control layer, similar to the evolution of cloud computing.

feed.title: Cms energy stock hits 52-week low at 67.19 USD
feed.summary: CMS Energy Corporation's stock has hit a 52-week low at $67.19, reflecting a 6.24% decline over the past year amidst broader energy sector challenges. Despite this, the company maintains a 3.37% dividend yield and has a long history of dividend increases. Recent developments include Q2 2026 adjusted earnings below expectations, a reaffirmed full-year outlook, and a filed Integrated Resource Plan focusing on clean energy.

feed.title: Cms Energy stock hits 52-week low at 20.25 USD
feed.summary: Cms Energy's stock has dropped to a 52-week low of $20.25, with its current price at $20.26 and a market capitalization of $21.22 billion. The company has seen a 1-year total return of -11.48%, falling from its 52-week high of $24.76. This decline highlights market volatility and challenges within the energy sector, prompting close monitoring from stakeholders.

feed.title: US Commerce Department finalizes steep duties on solar imports from India, Indonesia, Laos
feed.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department has finalized steep anti-dumping and countervailing duties on solar cells and panels imported from India, Indonesia, and Laos. These duties, ranging from 65.43% to 123.04% for anti-dumping and 73.2% to 173.7% for countervailing duties, were imposed after finding that producers in these countries dumped cheap products and benefited from unfair government subsidies. The move aims to enforce trade laws and restore fair competition for U.S. solar manufacturers, with a final determination by the U.S. International Trade Commission expected on October 14.

feed.title: Chemours to Pay $455 Million for Fayetteville Works Contamination
feed.summary: Chemours has agreed to pay $455 million over 15 years to North Carolina and 11 local entities to settle claims of PFAS contamination from its Fayetteville Works plant. This settlement is the largest environmental damage payment in North Carolina's history, with $75 million going to the state and $380 million to local governments. The agreement also includes a $135 million reserve fund from DuPont, Chemours' former parent company, to ensure payments in case Chemours faces bankruptcy.

feed.title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co stock hits 52-week low at 5.42 USD
feed.summary: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co's stock has hit a 52-week low of $5.42, marking a 35.72% decline over the past year due to market challenges and operational pressures, reflected in its weak gross profit margin of 18%. Despite these issues and a recent adjusted loss per share in Q2 2026, InvestingPro analysis suggests the stock might be undervalued. The company's Q2 revenue beat expectations but ongoing losses and cash burn have concerned investors.

feed.title: Gran Tierra Energy seeks noteholder consent for debt amendments
feed.summary: Gran Tierra Energy Inc. is soliciting consent from holders of its 9.750% Senior Secured Amortizing Notes due 2031 to amend the indenture governing the notes. These amendments are in connection with a previously announced asset sale to Établissements Maurel et Prom S.A. and would allow the purchaser to assume Gran Tierra's obligations under the notes. Noteholders who submit consent by September 22, 2026, are offered a fee of $2.50 per $1,000 principal amount, contingent on securing consents from at least 50% of outstanding notes and completing the sale.

feed.title: Gran Tierra Energy Launches Consent Solicitation for US$479M Senior Secured Notes Ahead of Colombia and Ecuador Asset Sale
feed.summary: Gran Tierra Energy Inc. is soliciting consents from holders of its US$479 million 9.750% Senior Secured Amortizing Notes due 2031. This action is crucial for amending the notes' indenture to facilitate the sale of its Colombia and Ecuador operations to Établissements Maurel et Prom S.A. The amendments aim to allow the purchaser to assume the notes and update certain financial definitions, with noteholders having until September 22, 2026, to consent for a fee of US$2.50 per US$1,000 principal.

feed.title: Can High Tide (NASDAQ:HITI) Weather A Tougher Market?
feed.summary: This article examines how High Tide (NASDAQ:HITI), a cannabis stock, is navigating the current challenging market environment characterized by elevated energy costs, firm Treasury yields, and renewed inflation concerns. The analysis focuses on how these macro pressures impact the company's regulatory developments, retail demand, brand execution, and balance-sheet discipline. It emphasizes that company-specific execution and operational efficiency are crucial for High Tide to maintain demand momentum and absorb higher costs in a volatile market.

feed.title: Humantic keeps humans in the loop at Five9
feed.summary: Five9 Inc. is implementing a "Humantic" contact center model, combining human and AI agents, rather than pursuing full automation. CEO Amit Mathradas states that this approach focuses on humans handling complex, high-value, or sensitive interactions, while AI manages high-volume, low-stakes tasks like password resets. This strategy addresses a market correction where customers still desire human interaction for critical issues, as evidenced by research showing a significant gap between business practitioners' and actual users' perceptions of AI's impact on contact center serviceability.

feed.title: Evolution Petroleum declares $0.12 quarterly dividend
feed.summary: Evolution Petroleum Corporation (NYSE American: EPM) announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share for its fiscal 2027 first quarter. This dividend will be paid on September 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 21, 2026, marking the company's 52nd consecutive quarterly cash dividend. Evolution Petroleum is an independent energy company focused on onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States.

feed.title: S&P Global downgrades Hormel Foods outlook on high leverage
feed.summary: S&P Global Ratings has downgraded Hormel Foods Corp.'s outlook from stable to negative due to sustained high leverage, which has consistently been at or above 1.8x, exceeding their expectations for the company's rating. The ratings agency projects Hormel's leverage to remain near this level through fiscal 2026, with only modest improvements expected in subsequent years, falling short of previous deleveraging forecasts. This negative outlook is also influenced by contracting EBITDA margins, rising input costs, and declining organic net sales, reflecting ongoing challenges in restoring and sustaining lower leverage levels.

feed.title: ESAB declares $0.12 quarterly dividend payable in October
feed.summary: ESAB Corporation has announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share of common stock. The dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of October 2, 2026. ESAB is an industrial company established in 1904, serving customers in approximately 150 countries.
